description: PR runs cost ~34 billed minutes (macOS 10x on a private repo), merges rerun the matrix, and the kernel cache (_build/test/defk) is never refreshed (key = mix.lock). Changes: one Linux job on PRs (full mix ci); the full matrix (gcc, aarch64, macOS) on release tags v* and on demand; no run on push to main; kernel cache key per week + sha with restore-keys, seeded by a weekly scheduled run on main; lint steps once; prebuilt CI image; timeout-minutes. Owner decision 2026-10-15: defer the full matrix to a release/tag.
title: CI: shorter, cheaper GitHub Actions runs; full matrix on release tags
